tools.name: track_parcel
tools.description: Track any parcel by tracking number (Thailand Post and other Thai carriers). Returns current status with Thai label plus the event history. Works without auth if the server has a tracking token configured; otherwise pass your Bearer token.

tools.name: get_order_statuses
tools.description: Reference data: the ProShip order status pipeline. Returns every status code with its Thai label and English meaning. Use these codes with list_orders and update_order_status.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Creates a real ProShip account and shop, ready for Thailand Post EPS (thaipost0) shipping. The response contains your API token, user, and shop_id — SHOWN ONLY ONCE. Save the token into your MCP client's Authorization header. A full thaipost contract additionally requires a Thailand Post account arr

tools.name: list_shops
tools.description: List the shops on YOUR ProShip account. Use the shop_id with create_order.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a shipment order. Defaults to Thailand Post EPS (thaipost0). Weight is in GRAMS. Returns the order_id — it contains a pipe suffix (order-xxx|123); always pass the FULL id to other tools. Optional cod_amount enables cash-on-delivery.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List orders on YOUR account. Optional numeric status filter (see get_order_statuses). Paginated.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id (full pipe-suffixed id is fine). Returns status with Thai label and tracking number.

tools.name: update_order_status
tools.description: Set an order status by numeric code (see get_order_statuses).

tools.name: check_duplicate
tools.description: Check whether a customer phone number already has a recent order (duplicate-shipment guard).

tools.name: print_label
tools.description: Generate the shipping label PDF for one or more orders. REQUIRES the FULL pipe-suffixed order ids (order-xxx|123) — stripped ids are rejected upstream. Returns a temporary URL (valid ~10 minutes) where the PDF can be downloaded.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "track_parcel" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
